Authors:Patrick Bajari, Zhihao Cen, Victor Chernozhukov, Manoj Manukonda, Suhas Vijaykumar, Jin Wang, Ramon Huerta, Junbo Li, Ling Leng, George Monokroussos, Shan Wan. View a PDF of the paper titled Hedonic Prices and Quality Adjusted Price Indices Powered by AI, by Patrick Bajari and 10 other authors. > Abstract:We develop empirical models that efficiently process large amounts of unstructured product data (text, images, prices, quantities) to produce accurate hedonic price estimates and derived indices. These attributes are then used to estimate the hedonic price function. To demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, we apply the models to Amazon's data for first-party apparel sales, and estimate hedonic prices. results.content: skip to main contentskip to footer. Target Circle™Target Circle™ CardTarget Circle 360™Registry & Wish ListWeekly AdFind Stores. # Value Bundles. ## Value Bundles. Instead of buying single items separately, value packs and multipacks let you stock up on everyday essentials at a lower cost per unit. Whether you’re shopping for household necessities, pantry staples, or personal care products, value bundles give you more for less—helping you save both time and money. Cost Savings: Buying in bulk often lowers the price per item, making value packs an affordable choice for families and budget-conscious shoppers. Convenience: Stocking up with multipacks means fewer trips to the store and less worry about running out of essentials. Sustainability: Purchasing in bulk reduces packaging waste and delivery frequency, making value bundles a smarter choice for the environment. Variety: Many value bundles are designed to give you different flavors, styles, or product variations in one purchase—perfect for households with multiple preferences. Families often choose multipacks of school snacks or drinks to keep pantries stocked, while bulk cleaning products are great for households that prioritize convenience and cost efficiency. Pantry Staples: Stock up on rice, pasta, or canned goods with bulk packs that last longer and save money. Having backup items stored away reduces last-minute store runs and ensures you’re prepared for guests, events, or even emergencies. For busy families, professionals, and bulk buyers, value bundles simplify shopping and stretch your budget further. If you’re looking to maximize your spending power without sacrificing quality, value bundles are the perfect solution. **Q: Are value bundles always cheaper than buying individual items?**. Buying in bulk reduces the cost per unit, though it’s always a good idea to compare prices to make sure you’re getting the best deal. **Q: Do multipacks expire faster since I’m buying more at once?**. Many products in value packs have long shelf lives, especially pantry staples and household supplies. Just be sure to store them properly. **Q: What’s the difference between multipacks and bulk bundles?**. A: A multipack usually includes several smaller packages bundled together (like snack bags), while bulk often means larger-sized products or higher quantities in one package. ### Get top deals, latest trends, and more. ## Footer.

results.content: # How to Create Eye-Catching Value Packs and Multipacks for Retail Stores. If you walk down the club store aisle at Costco, Sam’s Club, or BJ’s, you’ll see a common theme: value packs and multipacks wrapped in sleek, tight shrink film. Whether it’s cleaning supplies, dish soap, bug spray, or cat litter, bundling products into a retail-ready pack is a proven strategy to drive volume and customer loyalty. And what kind of **shrink wrap machine** do you need to ensure efficiency, safety, and minimal labor? ### Why Value Packs Work in Retail. Value packs and multi-unit club packs offer numerous advantages:. * Increased perceived value for consumers. * Convenient multi-use formats (e.g., disinfectants, air fresheners). * Cost-efficient packaging for brands and private labels. * Simplified handling and stocking for retailers. ### What to Look For in a Value Pack Shrink Wrap Machine. High-quality value packs require more than shrink film and heat. Look for machinery that can:. * Handle diverse products—bottles, cartons, spray cans, heavy bags. * Stack, stage, and wrap multiple units without damaging packaging. * Run clear or printed film for branding and regulatory needs. * Fast SKU and pack-size changeovers. * Durable machinery suited for continuous production. ### Popular Retail Multipack Formats. * 2-packs and 3-packs of bottles (e.g., detergents, cleaners). * 1x2 or 1x3 carton bundles with printed branding. * Heavy-bag formats (e.g., pet food, charcoal, soil). * Mix-and-match flavor or scent packs (e.g., air freshener blends). results.title: Multipacks: Combining Brands And Products For Better Sales
results.content: # Multipacks: Combining Brands And Products For Better Sales. Are you looking for a way to comingle several different brands and products into one package? Combining multiple products and brands into one package can help you sell more. And, when you combine several items into one multipack, you can often get eyes on some of your products that were largely unseen by buyers before. But what are the benefits of combining several products and brands into one package? After reading this article, you will know how multipacks can benefit your business and help you to sell more products. A multipack is a package featuring a selection of similar or identical items sold at a discounted price compared to buying each product separately. ## What Types Of Products Are Commonly Sold In Multipacks? You can find many products sold in multipacks, including cereal, soda, beer, shaving razors, soap, shampoo, bottled water, and countless other consumer goods. ## Why Use Multipacks To Comingle Multiple Brands And Products? One of the main reasons you may want to combine two or more products and brands into a multipack is that doing so can help you to sell more products. An excellent way to increase your sales is to comingle those items in a branded multipack. Getting those products together in a package that screams, "look at our value add," "look at our different offerings that you can buy in one container and have that one ticket item go across the scanner versus multiple ticket items." This is very appealing to the consumer. ## What Are Some Other Benefits Of Using Multipacks To Combine Brands And Products? If you have a great product that you really believe in, but it isn't getting the attention you think it should, using multipacks to piggyback with another brand is a great way to get that exposure you are looking for. After reading this article, you should understand the benefits of comingling brands and products with multipacks for your business. They will be able to answer any questions you have about comingling your brands and products into a multipack.
